status_contract.production: Qualified and accepted for the stated 1.0 contract. This baseline does not assign this status.
status_contract.experimental: Available within stated bounds. Shipping the operation in a preview does not establish production qualification.
status_contract.unsupported: The operation or the claimed ABI semantics are unavailable for this cell.

row_contract.scope: candidate_1_0 identifies a mandatory format/ISA/ABI tuple named by the roadmap. Operation-level acceptance is defined by the release journeys, and row scope does not qualify every operation. secondary is available for separate qualification. outside_1_0 remains out of the baseline 1.0 contract unless explicitly accepted.
row_contract.cell: Apply row operations to every element of target_abis. Resolve each operation through its capability for the status, limits and evidence. A typed ABI rejection does not remove loader, listing or other applicable native features.
row_contract.byte_order: Byte order refers to target data, not the Android host, the universal Mach-O outer table or A64 instruction bytes. A64 instructions are little-endian in both data orders.
row_contract.default: Unlisted format/ISA/byte-order tuples and unlisted typed ABI semantics are unsupported. An accepted container or instruction stream does not imply its ABI is modeled.
row_contract.evidence: Suite names identify coverage and rerun entry points. A source or suite reference alone does not imply this combination was executed in the latest release; release_observation distinguishes known preview evidence from unverified qualification.
row_contract.debug: External debug imports require a persistent compatible Program. An unverified acknowledgement never bypasses an actual mismatch.
row_contract.explicit_prototypes: Named ABIs describe the input program; explicit per-function prototypes can select another compatible convention independently of the default image ABI. For example, raw x86-64 accepts explicit Windows64 storage.

android_host.release_observation: 0.6 APK/AAB were verified with both host ABIs. Pixel 7a smoke used ARM64. Packaging x86_64 does not establish x86_64 Android device acceptance.

operations.load: Recognize the container and construct bounded image mappings.
operations.listing: Browse decoded instructions and mapped data.
operations.cfg: Discover routines and flow with explicit incomplete edges.
operations.lift: Lift modeled semantics to MintIR with explicit fallbacks.
operations.decompile: Emit SSA-backed pseudo-C and report limitations.
operations.interpreter: Interpret modeled MintIR using the native engine in a controlled host harness.
operations.typed_abi_storage: Model storage for authoritative prototypes under the named ABI.
operations.assembler: Assemble bounded instructions in the selected target mode.
operations.patch_export: Apply a bounded Program patch and export a new binary copy.
operations.debug_import: Read embedded or explicitly selected, verified external debug metadata.
operations.external_debug: Connect to an existing supported RSP/DAP endpoint and map image addresses explicitly.

native_listing.limits: Seven built-in modes; Capstone output is limited by decoding coverage and listing budgets.
native_listing.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

native_cfg.limits: No speculative edge for unknown/partial indirect targets. Bounded finite sets, instruction/recovery rounds and discovery resources. Default finite-set bounds are 32 values, 128 merged byte dependencies, 256 dataflow iterations and four million work steps per function. Native discovery attempts at most eight recovery/discovery rounds.
native_cfg.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

native_lift.limits: ISA families vary. Unsupported semantics remain explicit intrinsics.
native_lift.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

native_c.limits: Typed ABI/alias/region evidence is bounded. Unknown status and terminal transfer stay explicit.
native_c.release_observation: 0.6 headless and Pixel 7a Pseudo-C status/navigation smoke; no exhaustive per-target result.

native_ir_execution.limits: Native host test harness for modeled IR semantics. No general Android workspace/headless emulation action, process emulation, or proof about unsupported intrinsics.
native_ir_execution.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

native_assembler.limits: Implemented scalar syntax; no complete ISA assembler, object linker, arbitrary relaxation or unproven interworking.
native_assembler.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

native_patch.limits: Validated file-backed writes to an overlay. Export creates a copy; no insertion, arbitrary metadata rebuild, or patch of virtual zero-fill.
native_patch.release_observation: 0.6 verifies fault recovery and incremental-vs-full on controlled fixtures.

native_debug.limits: Existing numeric endpoint and explicit map-image. Varies by advertised RSP/DAP capabilities and register layout; no guessed ASLR mapping and no portable RSP stack unwind. No comprehensive real-server qualification.
native_debug.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

native_debug_be.limits: Explicit target data byte order used for known RSP PC registers. Same bounded endpoint and image mapping requirements as native_debug.
native_debug_be.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dwarf_import.limits: Supported DWARF 2–5, representable types/locations and identity-checked compatible external ELF, compressed and selected split forms. Unsupported records defer; unmatched identities fail.
dwarf_import.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dwarf_import_be.limits: AArch64 big-endian data with compatible external ELF. Available identity and byte-order mismatches fail. Support is bounded to implemented DWARF forms.
dwarf_import_be.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

pdb_import.limits: Selected PDB7/CodeView and OMAPFROM evidence linked to the PE image. No general type servers or Windows debug layout parity.
pdb_import.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

debug_raw.limits: No embedded sections or image identity. A compatible external debug object requires matching architecture, width and byte order, and explicit unverified acknowledgement when no identity evidence exists. No raw symbol/mapping relocation is inferred.
debug_raw.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

macho_debug.limits: No qualified Mach-O/dSYM UUID binding. The external reader accepts supported ELF debug objects and PE-bound PDB, not general dSYM imports.

elf64_load.limits: ELF64 executables and shared libraries, including stripped variants. Implemented relocation/PLT/unwind metadata, not a process loader.
elf64_load.release_observation: 0.6 compiler corpus validated 8 AArch64/x86-64 ELF64 across debug/stripped and shared/executable variants.

elf64_be_load.limits: AArch64 big-endian ELF64 data, little-endian A64 instructions. Other big-endian ELF64 ISAs unsupported.
elf64_be_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

elf32_load.limits: Little-endian ET_EXEC/ET_DYN and bounded ET_REL synthetic mappings. Instruction relocations are metadata, not linked bytes.
elf32_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

pe32_load.limits: i386 PE32 only. Preferred image VAs, supported import/export/delay-import/relocation inventory. No general rebase.
pe32_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

pe64_load.limits: x86-64 and AArch64 PE32+ at preferred VAs. Supported import/relocation/runtime function/CodeView metadata; no general Windows loader or exception runtime.
pe64_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

macho_load.limits: Little-endian thin Mach-O only. Some dyld bind/rebase/export/chained fixup and compact unwind encodings; layout can be incomplete.
macho_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

macho_fat_load.limits: Validated outer slice table with one supported little-endian slice selected. Explicit architecture selection retains distinct project identity.
macho_fat_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

macho_fat_patch.limits: Only selected-slice mapped bytes are patched. Whole-container export retains other slices unchanged.
macho_fat_patch.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

raw_load.limits: Explicit ISA/mode, in-range aligned base/entry and single executable mapping. No automatic fallback to raw or synthesized system metadata.
raw_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

raw_be_load.limits: Explicit AArch64 big-endian data only. Data order is part of raw project identity.
raw_be_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

aapcs64.limits: Authoritative GP/FP, documented stack spill/hidden return and bounded aggregate storage. No complete unnamed variadics or automatic aggregate recovery.
aapcs64.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

sysv64.limits: Supported declarations and bounded scalar call recovery. Typed tail-call emission needs compatible declarations and proven simple register arguments.
sysv64.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

windows64.limits: AMD64 Windows64 declarations with shadow space. Automatic Windows prototype inference is disabled.
windows64.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

windows_arm64.limits: PE32+ loader accepts ARM64; the Windows64 ABI matcher is x86-64 only. Generic AAPCS64 storage does not establish a Windows ARM64 ABI.

cdecl_stdcall.limits: 32-bit stack storage for supported authoritative declarations. Automatic recovery of stack call arguments is limited.
cdecl_stdcall.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

aapcs32.limits: Select the base/soft-float convention for proven binaries only. VFP hard-float packing/backfill is unavailable; lifting some VFP opcodes does not implement its ABI.
aapcs32.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

aapcs32_vfp.limits: Explicitly rejected by the ABI model; loader, listing and scalar analysis can still open the image.

riscv_abi.limits: RV32/RV64 integer and F/D storage for supported declarations and composites. ELF flags select the default; raw uses integer default unless explicitly overridden.
riscv_abi.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

riscv_eq.limits: E/Q flag values are recognized as unsupported ABI names; full E/Q storage is not implemented.

mach_arm_abi.limits: Generic AAPCS models only; Darwin-specific platform ABI differences are not qualified.
mach_arm_abi.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

mach_x86_abi.limits: Generic SysV AMD64 or cdecl32 model as applicable. Darwin-specific ABI exceptions and complete platform qualification remain pending.
mach_x86_abi.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

cfg_a64.limits: Bounded native discovery, AArch64 linear sweep fallback, supported PIC tables and finite-set indirect flow. Unknown/disagreeing targets remain partial.
cfg_a64.release_observation: 0.6 production-corpus fixtures verify discovered functions, call targets and loop CFG.

cfg_x64.limits: Bounded ELF64 PIC signed-rel32 switches with proven guards/index, groups of labels, verified direct tail cases. Unproven bounds/targets and unsupported patterns fall back.
cfg_x64.release_observation: 0.6 optimized Clang O2 fixture and negative index/upper-bit tests passed.

lift_arm.limits: Scalar, selected VFP and integer NEON, a subset of predicated register/flag changes and Thumb IT; unsupported predicated calls, memory or PC changes remain opaque.
lift_arm.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

lift_rv.limits: Integer/M, common compressed scalar, selected F/D and AMO operations. LR/SC, some rounding, vector and privileged semantics retain explicit fallbacks.
lift_rv.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dalvik_load.limits: Legacy DEX with supported headers, tables and opcodes. No full multidex or native-app analysis through this route.
dalvik_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

apk_load.limits: Validates bounded ZIP and extracts classes.dex only; resources, manifest semantics and secondary DEX are outside this route.
apk_load.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dalvik_list.limits: List known method instructions. Native xref/search/ABI facilities do not qualify this legacy path.
dalvik_list.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dalvik_flow.limits: Bounded CFG and partial method lifting. Unsupported instructions stay explicit; this is not an ART execution model.
dalvik_flow.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dalvik_c.limits: SSA/pseudo-C through the partial Dalvik lifter. Decompile report explicitly marks the Dalvik path partial.
dalvik_c.release_observation: Suite listed for qualification; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

dalvik_none.limits: No supported DEX/APK interpreter, typed native ABI, assembler or patch export, native debug import, or mapped external debugger workflow.

unsupported_tuple.limits: Unsupported format/ISA/byte-order combination. Refuse the input or require an explicitly supported loader/mapping.

elf64_rv_load.limits: Little-endian ELF64/RISC-V executables and shared libraries. Storage and analysis support depend on the ABI flags and ISA operations.
elf64_rv_load.release_observation: Compiler corpus available; no per-cell 0.6 result asserted.

explicit_loader_exclusions.reason: The big-endian ELF64 implementation requires AArch64.
